verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair axis for a SaaS scheduling assistant, but the evidence pack documents no Reclaim export feature or open-format download of user data. Reclaim's events living in the user's Google or Outlook calendar is a host-platform property, and the auth-gated MCP endpoint with read scopes is a developer building block; neither counts as a first-party export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
